verdict.rationale: New Relic's alerting lets users define rules on any signal: NRQL conditions, thresholds, or anomaly detection. When a rule fires, the platform automatically notifies chosen people and routes issues to other systems or teams. Separately, the vulnerability agent can open Jira or GitHub issues that kick off coding agents. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of action types beyond notifications (webhooks, workflow or runbook execution, automated remediation details beyond a marketing tagline) and independent or hands-on corroboration.
